entities.name: RecX (query sequence)
observations: 264-aa sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt A5VLA3 and B2G8N1 RecX proteins from Limosilactobacillus reuteri.
Reviewed matching RecX annotation states that it modulates RecA activity; cytoplasmic localization and GO:0006282 regulation of DNA repair are annotated.

entities.name: DNA repair regulation
observations: RecX reference annotations associate the protein with regulation of DNA repair (GO:0006282).
